name: UDR

logo.source: companieslogo.com vector of the UDR monogram (the Wikipedia infobox PNG and udr.com header PNG are only 70x80 px, too small)

description: UDR owns, operates, renovates, develops and manages apartment communities in 21 US markets. At Dec 31, 2025 its consolidated portfolio was 165 communities with 55,240 completed apartment homes, with another 12,167 homes held through unconsolidated joint ventures and partnerships; one 300-home development was under way. Income is monthly apartment rent, and 95% of total NOI comes from its Same-Store communities. It also earns fees from joint ventures and made $72.6M of preferred equity investments in 2025.

businessLines.how: Same monthly rent while new buildings stabilize, plus JV management fees ($11.4M in 2025).
businessLines.description: Recently acquired, developed or redeveloped communities, non-apartment parts of mixed-use buildings and JV management fees.
